entities.name: DETACH ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by the network to indicate that the detach procedure has been completed. Direction is from network to UE.

entities.name: Protocol discriminator
entities.description: Identifies the protocol type. Mandatory IE in DETACH ACCEPT message.

entities.name: Security header type
entities.description: Specifies the security header format. Mandatory IE in DETACH ACCEPT message.

entities.name: Detach accept message identity
entities.description: Identifies the message type as DETACH ACCEPT. Mandatory IE in DETACH ACCEPT message.

entities.name: UE originating detach procedure
entities.description: Procedure where the UE initiates detach from the network. Completion is indicated by the DETACH ACCEPT message.

relations.description: The UE originating detach procedure includes the network sending DETACH ACCEPT message to indicate completion.
DETACH ACCEPT message contains the Protocol discriminator information element.
DETACH ACCEPT message contains the Security header type information element.
DETACH ACCEPT message contains the Detach accept message identity information element.
